text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone call my pranks stale, 
noda! I'll pull off a huge one and stun 
them all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I thought, but no good ideas come 
to mind, noda. I've already pulled off 
most kinds of pranks—

text_block_list.name: Dancing Passersby
text_block_list.text:
La~ la~ ♪ A birthday just once a year ♪ 
The special twentieth birthday ♪ Stepping 
into adulthood starting today~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Dancing Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday to you ♪ Happy memory to 
you ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What in the world is that, noda!? The 
passersby suddenly broke into dance, 
noda!?

text_block_list.name: Surprised Passersby A
text_block_list.text:
Woow! That's gotta be a surprise 
performance! I saw something like this on 
TV before!

text_block_list.name: Surprised Passersby B
text_block_list.text:
They started dancing out of nowhere, 
totally startled me! I won't be forgetting 
this for a while~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Th... This is it, nodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I made a crown out of pretty flowers, 
noda! If I dance with this, Windy-chan 
will undoubtedly be the center of 
attention, noda!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! What a lovely flower crown...! May I 
take a closer look?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's not the part you're supposed to 
look at, nodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Teryaryaryarya~ ♪ Behold Windy-chan's deft 
hand movements, noda~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that is a martial art I have not 
witnessed before. Could it be a new 
discipline?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looks kinda fun! I'd love to learn the 
katas and train right alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This mysterious stone I picked up outside 
Tachyon's lab that absorbs light and 
shines... I'll use this to startle 
everyone, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Go on, mysterious stone! Soak up the stage 
lights and make Windy-chan shine, noda! 
Make me super blindingly bright, nodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what an utterly magnificent one-man 
show! A brilliance that threatens to burn 
even the Century's End Overlord's eyes... 
Truly a shining new star among actors! 
Bravoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Awa-wawa...! Windy-san's ears and tail 
suddenly drooped, didn't they? D-Did 
something bad happen...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. According to the Digi-tan Eye 
analysis, what reflects in Windy-san's 
eyes is fluster, bewilderment... and 
sorrow. I'm a bit concerned.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, this reaction feels just like 
when I pulled pranks before, noda. This is 
a bad trend, noda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Giving up is not allowed, noda! 
This time for sure, I'll stun everyone 
with an amazing surprise, noda!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's Windy. Are you cheering for 
someone by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Way-way-waaay! What's up, bestie? You're 
doing a total hype dance, but your face 
looks completely mentally broken!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I see. You want a new way to startle 
people that isn't stale, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right, noda! But even though I 
tried all sorts of stuff, nothing is 
working out at all, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh~! At this rate, Hishi Ama and 
everyone else will keep underestimating 
me, nodaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if you wanna pull off a flashy prank, 
wouldn't it be better to have some 
accomplices? Just like that flash mob 
surprise you saw.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real! Totally agree! More peeps means 
vibes blasted to max overdrive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's go gather people! By the 
way, I totally love that kind of thing, so 
maybe I'm interested~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Big mood! If we drop it together with all 
our fav faves, our youth will be the 
absolute GOATest~~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I-Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then it can't be helped! I'll make the two 
of you my henchmen, noda! Lend me your 
power to spread the greatness of 
Windy-chan, noda!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! So, what about you two 
watching over there? Wanna join in?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Awawa!? You noticed us!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-As for Digi-tan, I feel a 1000% sense of 
unworthiness, but if I can be of service 
to my precious fave, I shall gladly work 
my fingers to the bone, sir!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't really know what we'll be 
doing, but if it cheers Windy-san up, 
then...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, my crew suddenly grew a whole 
bunch, noda! As expected of Windy-chan, my 
own charisma is truly terrifying, noda!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this momentum, we'll definitely 
catch everyone completely off guard, noda! 
Alright, let's do this, noda!

As Shinko Windy and the others happily 
hatched their plan, their interaction 
looked utterly heartwarming in the eyes of 
everyone around them.
